citation.title: Ethnic differences in beta cell function occur independently of insulin sensitivity and pancreatic fat in black and white men

population.description: 23 white (Northern) European men, the reference group of the paper (Table 1, WE column; screening values, mean (SD)). Normally glucose-tolerant by WHO criteria on a 75 g OGTT at screening; diabetes and impaired glucose tolerance excluded, so healthy. BMI 26.5 (SD 4.6) is the paper's own figure (overweight, mildly). The black African group (n 23) is not entered: ethnicity is not a factor the model is told, and two groups cannot be two arms. The paper names neither group the reference (Table 2 differences are WE minus BA, ratios WE over BA); WE is the one group entered, BA left out (see left_out).

protocols.name: screen_seated
protocols.description: Screening visit, WE men: seated blood pressure after a 10-hour fast (Methods: 'following a 10-hour fast'; 'seated blood pressure'; posture and fed state both printed). Arm of 30 min, the single measurement read at minutes 29-30 (the corpus form for one sample after a fast); clock hour not printed, 8.0 assumed; the paper does not say when in the visit the pressure was taken, 30 min assumed.

protocols.name: mmtt_fasting
protocols.description: Fasting samples of the mixed meal test, WE men: 'following an overnight fast' (Methods, MMTT); two fasting samples at -10 and 0 min, 10 min apart. Arm of 11 min = paper minutes -10 to 0 (arm minute 0 is paper -10, arm minute 10 is paper 0); the drink is given after the arm ends, so no meal. Clock hour not printed, 8.0 assumed. Table 2 does not name the visit of its fasting rows (the study also had a clamp visit with basal samples at -30 to 0 min); read here as the MMTT's fasting samples because the text sets the table beside the meal-test responses and GLP-1/GIP were drawn only in the MMTT. The paper does not say whether 'fasting' is the mean of the -10 and 0 samples or the 0 sample alone; the mean is read. 'Overnight fast' with 'food and drink for at least 10 hours' is a lower bound, so prefast_hours 10 is assumed.
